findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: model_switch_cost · Private data: real_cost_per_result, model_prices, launch_checklist · Public sink: real_cost_per_result, model_switch_cost, build_judge_prompt · Destructive: build_judge_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: model_switch_cost · Private data: real_cost_per_result, model_prices, launch_checklist · Public sink: real_cost_per_result, model_switch_cost, build_judge_prompt · Destructive: build_judge_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
